prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The soup smells deliciously.
The soup smells delicious.
The soup smells like deliciously.
answer: The soup smells delicious.

smell 在這裡是連綴動詞，後面要接形容詞當補語，不能用副詞 deliciously。
like 後面要接名詞，不能接副詞；而且這句根本不需要 like。

why: smell、taste、sound、look 這類連綴動詞後面接形容詞，描述主詞的狀態。
tip: 感官動詞當連綴動詞時，後面接形容詞不接副詞。
say: The soup smells delicious.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The coach believes _____ our team can win the final.
options: that
what
whether to
answer: that

wrong.what: what 在名詞子句中要當主詞或受詞，但後面 our team can win 已經是完整句子，不需要 what。
wrong.whether to: whether to 後面要接原形動詞，不能接完整的子句 our team can win。

why: believe 後面可接 that 子句，that 後是完整句子，that 在口語中也可省略。
tip: that 子句後面接完整句子，what 子句後面會缺成分。
say: The coach believes that our team can win the final.

prompt: 這句話的意思最接近哪一個？
text: The new rule seems fair, but it has not been tested yet.
options: 這條新規定看起來公平，但還沒有經過實際檢驗。
這條新規定很不公平，所以沒有人使用。
這條新規定已經測試過，結果很公平。
answer: 這條新規定看起來公平，但還沒有經過實際檢驗。

wrong.這條新規定很不公平，所以沒有人使用。: seems fair 的意思是看起來公平，不是不公平；原句也沒有說沒人使用。
wrong.這條新規定已經測試過，結果很公平。: has not been tested yet 表示還沒測試，與已經測試過相反。

why: seems 表示看起來如此，but 後面補充還沒驗證，所以公平只是表面印象。
tip: seem 只說看起來如何，不等於事實已經證實。
say: The new rule seems fair, but it has not been tested yet.

prompt: 你想問同學：他有沒有說明天會不會下雨？哪一句最自然？
options: Did he say whether it will rain tomorrow?
Did he say whether will it rain tomorrow?
Did he say that will it rain tomorrow?
answer: Did he say whether it will rain tomorrow?

wrong.Did he say whether will it rain tomorrow: 名詞子句要用肯定句的順序 it will rain，不能把 will 提前變成疑問句。
wrong.Did he say that will it rain tomorrow?: that 子句同樣不能倒裝，而且問是否會下雨應該用 whether。

why: 間接問句中，whether 後面接肯定句語序：主詞 it 在前，will rain 在後。
tip: 間接問句不倒裝，主詞放在動詞前面。
say: Did he say whether it will rain tomorrow?

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I am agree with your opinion.
I agree with your opinion.
I agree to with your opinion.
answer: I agree with your opinion.

agree 本身就是動詞，不能再加 be 動詞 am，這是受中文「我是同意」影響的錯誤。
to 和 with 兩個介系詞不能連用，同意某人的意見用 agree with。

why: agree 是一般動詞，同意某人或某看法用 agree with。
tip: agree 是動詞，前面不加 am、is、are。
say: I agree with your opinion.

prompt: 選出適合的關係詞。
text: The girl _____ sits next to me is a famous swimmer.
options: who
whom
which
answer: who

wrong.whom: whom 是受格，但這裡的關係詞要當子句的主詞（sits 的主詞），所以要用 who。
wrong.which: which 用來指事物，這裡指的是 the girl，是人。

why: 先行詞 the girl 是人，關係詞在子句中當主詞，所以用 who。
tip: 先行詞是人、又當子句主詞時，用 who。
say: The girl who sits next to me is a famous swimmer.

prompt: The mayor became a teacher after retiring. 這句話表示什麼？
options: 市長退休後變成了老師。
市長退休後去幫老師的忙。
市長是一位退休的老師。
answer: 市長退休後變成了老師。

wrong.市長退休後去幫老師的忙。: became 是連綴動詞，表示變成，後面的 a teacher 說明身份，不是幫忙老師。
wrong.市長是一位退休的老師。: 原句順序是先當市長、退休後才成為老師，不是老師退休。

why: become + 名詞，表示從原本的身份轉變成另一個身份。
tip: become 加名詞，表示身份改變成為什麼。
say: The mayor became a teacher after retiring.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The fact is that he has no experience.
The fact is what he has no experience.
The fact is he has no experiences that.
answer: The fact is that he has no experience.

what 引導的子句本身要缺主詞或受詞，但 he has no experience 已經完整，應該用 that。
that 不能放在句尾，而且 experience 表示經驗時通常不可數。

why: The fact is that + 完整句子，that 子句當補語說明事實的內容。
tip: The fact is that 後面接完整句子說明事實。
say: The fact is that he has no experience.

prompt: 朋友問你的看法，你想委婉說「我覺得這個計畫不太可行」，哪句最合適？
options: In my opinion, the plan is not very practical.
By my opinion, the plan is not very practical.
As my opinion, the plan is not very practical.
answer: In my opinion, the plan is not very practical.

wrong.By my opinion, the plan is not very prac: 表達「依我之見」的固定說法是 in my opinion，不用 by。
wrong.As my opinion, the plan is not very prac: as 在這裡不能表達觀點，會變成「作為我的意見」，語意不通順。

why: in my opinion 是固定用語，用來表示個人觀點，比直接說 It is bad 更委婉。
tip: 表達個人觀點用 in my opinion，介系詞用 in。
say: In my opinion, the plan is not very practical.

prompt: 選出最適合的動詞形式。
text: It is important that every student _____ the safety rules.
options: follow
follows
followed
answer: follow

wrong.follows: important that 後面的子句要用假設語氣，動詞用原形，不加 s。
wrong.followed: 這裡表示建議或要求，要用原形動詞，不是過去式。

why: 表示重要、必要、建議的形容詞後面，that 子句用 (should) + 原形動詞。
tip: It is important that 後面，動詞用原形。
say: It is important that every student follow the safety rules.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Mr. Lin, who is my uncle, teaches math.
Mr. Lin, that is my uncle, teaches math.
Mr. Lin, he is my uncle, teaches math.
answer: Mr. Lin, who is my uncle, teaches math.

補充說明的非限定子句，關係詞不能用 that，要用 who。
這樣變成兩個句子硬接在一起，he 前面需要關係詞 who 來連接。

why: 逗號後補充說明人的資訊，用 who，而且不能用 that。
tip: 逗號後的補充說明，關係詞不能用 that。
say: Mr. Lin, who is my uncle, teaches math.

prompt: The speaker sounded confident. 這句話表示什麼？
options: 講者聽起來很有自信。
講者聲音很大聲。
講者感到很緊張。
answer: 講者聽起來很有自信。

wrong.講者聲音很大聲。: sounded confident 說的是給人的感覺有自信，與音量大小無關。
wrong.講者感到很緊張。: confident 是有自信，與緊張相反。

why: sound + 形容詞表示聽起來如何，confident 是有自信的。
tip: sound 後面接形容詞，表示聽起來怎麼樣。
say: The speaker sounded confident.

prompt: 老師問：「這個點子是誰想出來的？」你想回答「是小婷想到的」，哪一句最自然？
options: It was Ting who came up with the idea.
It was Ting which came up with the idea.
It was Ting what came up with the idea.
answer: It was Ting who came up with the idea.

which 指事物，Ting 是人，應該用 who。
what 不能用在強調句中替代人，這裡要用 who 或 that。

why: 強調句型 It was + 人 + who/that + 動詞，用來強調做這件事的人。
tip: 強調人時用 It was ... who，後面接動作。
say: It was Ting who came up with the idea.

prompt: 選出最適合的字。
text: I can't decide _____ to take the bus or the MRT.
options: whether
if that
what
answer: whether

wrong.if that: if 和 that 不能這樣連用，而且「要不要」的選擇需要 whether。
wrong.what: what 是「什麼」，但這裡是在兩個選項中二選一，應該用 whether。

why: whether ... or ... 表示在兩個選項中選擇，可以接 to 不定詞。
tip: 二選一要決定時，用 whether ... or ...。
say: I can't decide whether to take the bus or the MRT.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The news that he won surprised everyone.
The news what he won surprised everyone.
The news which he won it surprised everyone.
answer: The news that he won surprised everyone.

同位語子句要用 that 引導，不能用 what。
wrong.The news which he won it surprised every: which 子句不需要再加 it，而且這裡是同位語子句，應該用 that。

why: that he won 是說明 the news 內容的同位語子句，由 that 引導。
tip: news、fact、idea 後面的內容子句用 that。
say: The news that he won surprised everyone.

prompt: 選出下列句子最合理的解讀。
text: The poster was designed by a student, but the school got the credit.
options: 學生設計海報，但功勞被學校拿走了。
學校設計海報，學生得到功勞。
學生和學校一起設計了海報。
answer: 學生設計海報，但功勞被學校拿走了。

wrong.學校設計海報，學生得到功勞。: was designed by a student 說明設計者是學生，不是學校。
wrong.學生和學校一起設計了海報。: 句子用 but 表示轉折，說的是設計者與得到功勞的人不同，不是一起設計。

why: 被動語態 by a student 指出動作的執行者，but 說明功勞給了別人。
tip: 被動句的 by 後面是真正做事的人。
say: The poster was designed by a student, but the school got the credit.

prompt: 你想請別人換個角度想想看，哪一句最合適？
options: Try to look at it from a different point of view.
Try to look at it by a different point of view.
Try to look at it for a different point of view.
answer: Try to look at it from a different point of view.

wrong.Try to look at it by a different point o: from a point of view 才是固定用法，by 沒有「從某角度」的意思。
wrong.Try to look at it for a different point: for 表示目的或對象，不能表達「從某個角度」。

why: from a ... point of view 是固定說法，表示從某個角度看事情。
tip: 從某個角度看，介系詞用 from。
say: Try to look at it from a different point of view.

prompt: 選出最適合的字。
text: The article _____ pollution is a serious problem in many cities.
options: points out that
points out what
points out to
answer: points out that

wrong.points out what: what 子句會缺主詞或受詞，但後面 pollution is a serious problem 是完整句子。
wrong.points out to: point out to 後面要接人或事物，不能直接接完整句子。

why: point out 後面可接 that 子句，表示指出某個事實。
tip: point out 後面接 that 加完整句子。
say: The article points out that pollution is a serious problem in many cities.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: She became a nurse because she likes helping people.
She became nurse because she likes help people.
She became a nurse because she likes to helping people.
answer: She became a nurse because she likes helping people.

wrong.She became nurse because she likes help: 單數可數名詞 nurse 前要加 a；likes 後面也不能直接接原形動詞。
wrong.She became a nurse because she likes to: to 後面要接原形，to helping 的形式不正確，應該是 to help 或 helping。

why: nurse 是可數名詞，要加 a；like 後面接動名詞 helping 或 to help。
tip: 表示職業身份的單數名詞前，通常要加 a。
say: She became a nurse because she likes helping people.

prompt: Jack remained silent during the meeting. 這句話表示什麼？
options: 傑克在會議中一直保持沉默。
傑克在會議中保持安靜地離開。
傑克在會議後才保持安靜。
answer: 傑克在會議中一直保持沉默。

wrong.傑克在會議中保持安靜地離開。: remained 是保持，沒有離開的意思。
wrong.傑克在會議後才保持安靜。: during the meeting 表示會議進行期間，不是會議結束後。

why: remain + 形容詞，表示維持某種狀態；during 指整段期間。
tip: remain 加形容詞，表示維持原本的狀態。
say: Jack remained silent during the meeting.

prompt: 你想用一句話說明「她是我們班上最會唱歌的人」，哪一句最自然？
options: She is the best singer in our class.
She is the best singer of our class.
She is the most good singer in our class.
answer: She is the best singer in our class.

最高級後面表示範圍時，單數集合名詞通常用 in，of 用於複數，例如 of all the students。
wrong.She is the most good singer in our class: good 的最高級是 best，不能說 most good。

why: good 的最高級是 best，範圍是團體或地點時用 in our class。
tip: 最高級的範圍是單位地點，常用 in。
say: She is the best singer in our class.

prompt: 選出最適合的關係詞。
text: This is the house _____ my grandfather was born.
options: where
which
who
answer: where

wrong.which: which 在子句中要當主詞或受詞，但 my grandfather was born 後面缺的是地點副詞。
wrong.who: who 指人，這裡的先行詞 the house 是地方。

why: 先行詞是地點，且關係詞在子句中當地方副詞，用 where。
tip: 先行詞是地點，子句內需要地點副詞，用 where。
say: This is the house where my grandfather was born.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: It is said that the museum was built in 1950.
It is said that the museum built in 1950.
It says that the museum was built in 1950.
answer: It is said that the museum was built in 1950.

wrong.It is said that the museum built in 1950: 博物館是被建造的，要用被動 was built，不是主動 built。
wrong.It says that the museum was built in 195: It says 的主詞 it 很難說明是誰在說；表示「據說」應該用 It is said that。

why: It is said that ... 是「據說」的句型；博物館被建造，用被動 was built。
tip: 據說用 It is said that，後面接完整句子。
say: It is said that the museum was built in 1950.

prompt: 選出最接近下句意思的選項。
text: No one can deny that exercise keeps us healthy.
options: 每個人都同意運動使我們健康。
有些人認為運動並不健康。
沒有人知道運動是否有益。
answer: 每個人都同意運動使我們健康。

wrong.有些人認為運動並不健康。: No one can deny 表示沒人能否認，並不是有人反對。
wrong.沒有人知道運動是否有益。: 原句肯定運動有益，不是不知道。

why: No one can deny that ... 是雙重否定，等於大家都承認該事實。
tip: no one can deny 表示大家都承認為真。
say: No one can deny that exercise keeps us healthy.

prompt: 同學問你對新校規的看法，你想說「這要看情況」，哪一句最自然？
options: It depends on the situation.
It depends the situation.
It is depend on the situation.
answer: It depends on the situation.

depend 是不及物動詞，後面要加介系詞 on 才能接名詞。
depend 是動詞，前面不能再加 is。

why: depend on 是固定搭配，表示取決於。
tip: depend 後面要接 on，不能少。
say: It depends on the situation.

prompt: 選出最適合的字。
text: _____ you said yesterday made me think a lot.
options: What
That
Which
answer: What

wrong.That: that 引導的子句本身要完整，但 you said 缺少受詞，需要 what 來當 said 的受詞。
wrong.Which: which 不能直接當名詞子句的開頭來表示「所說的事」，要用 what。

why: What you said 是名詞子句當主詞，what 同時是 said 的受詞，意思是你所說的話。
tip: 子句缺受詞或主詞又當名詞用，選 what。
say: What you said yesterday made me think a lot.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
The movie was so boring that I fell asleep it.
The movie was such boring that I fell asleep.
answer: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.

wrong.The movie was so boring that I fell asle: fell asleep 後面不需要再加 it，多出來的 it 不通順。
wrong.The movie was such boring that I fell as: such 後面要接名詞，boring 是形容詞，應該用 so boring。

why: so + 形容詞 + that 表示結果，電影無聊到讓我睡著。
tip: so 加形容詞，such 加名詞，後面接 that 表示結果。
say: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.

prompt: The manager is known as a fair leader. 這句話表示什麼？
options: 大家都知道經理是個公平的領導者。
經理想要成為公平的領導者。
經理認識一位公平的領導者。
answer: 大家都知道經理是個公平的領導者。

wrong.經理想要成為公平的領導者。: is known as 表示被認為是，不是想要成為。
wrong.經理認識一位公平的領導者。: known as 說的是經理自己的身份，不是他認識別人。

why: be known as + 身份，表示以某種身份而聞名。
tip: be known as 後面接身份或角色。
say: The manager is known as a fair leader.

prompt: 朋友一直自己決定所有事，你想提醒他「也要聽聽別人的意見」，哪一句最合適？
options: You should also listen to other people's opinions.
You should also listen other people's opinions.
You should also hear to other people's opinions.
answer: You should also listen to other people's opinions.

wrong.You should also listen other people's op: listen 是不及物動詞，要加 to 才能接受詞。
wrong.You should also hear to other people's o: hear 是及物動詞，不加 to；表示專心聽應該用 listen to。

why: listen to 表示專心聽，想請對方留意別人的看法時使用。
tip: listen 後面接人或聲音時要加 to。
say: You should also listen to other people's opinions.

prompt: 選出最適合的字。
text: The reason _____ I was late is that my bike broke down.
options: why
what
whose
answer: why

wrong.what: what 要當名詞子句開頭，不能接在 the reason 後面當關係詞。
wrong.whose: whose 表示所有格，但這裡是說明遲到的原因，不是誰的東西。

why: 先行詞是 the reason，關係副詞用 why 引導原因。
tip: 先行詞是 the reason，關係詞用 why。
say: The reason why I was late is that my bike broke down.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Not only Amy but also her brother is good at chess.
Not only Amy but also her brother are good at chess.
Not only Amy and also her brother is good at chess.
answer: Not only Amy but also her brother is good at chess.

wrong.Not only Amy but also her brother are go: not only ... but also ... 的動詞要和靠近的主詞 her brother 一致，所以用 is。
wrong.Not only Amy and also her brother is goo: 固定搭配是 not only ... but also ...，不是 and also。

why: not only A but also B 連接兩個主詞時，動詞與靠近的 B 一致。
tip: not only A but also B，動詞跟 B 一致。
say: Not only Amy but also her brother is good at chess.

prompt: 選出最合理的解讀。
text: Although the plan looked perfect, it failed in practice.
options: 計畫看起來完美，實際執行卻失敗了。
計畫看起來糟糕，實際上卻成功了。
計畫沒有經過討論就失敗了。
answer: 計畫看起來完美，實際執行卻失敗了。

wrong.計畫看起來糟糕，實際上卻成功了。: 句中 perfect 是完美、failed 是失敗，兩者與選項說法相反。
wrong.計畫沒有經過討論就失敗了。: 原句沒有提到討論，而是說明外表與實際結果的對比。

why: Although 引導讓步子句，表示前後對比：看起來好，結果卻不好。
tip: although 帶出前後相反的對比。
say: Although the plan looked perfect, it failed in practice.

prompt: 你想禮貌地表示自己不同意對方，哪一句最合適？
options: I see your point, but I don't quite agree.
I see your point, so I don't quite agree.
I see your point, or I don't quite agree.
answer: I see your point, but I don't quite agree.

wrong.I see your point, so I don't quite agree: so 表示因果，但理解對方並不是不同意的原因；這裡應該用 but 表示轉折。
wrong.I see your point, or I don't quite agree: or 表示二選一，語意變成不明確，無法表達委婉的不同意。

why: 先承認對方有道理，再用 but 表示不同意，語氣比較委婉。
tip: 委婉反對，先肯定再用 but 轉折。
say: I see your point, but I don't quite agree.

prompt: 選出最適合的字。
text: Everyone knows _____ the Earth goes around the Sun.
options: that
what
where
answer: that

wrong.what: what 子句內需要缺一個成分，但 the Earth goes around the Sun 已經完整。
wrong.where: where 表示地點，這句話的內容是事實，不是在說地點。

why: know 後面的名詞子句如果是完整句子，用 that 引導。
tip: 完整句子當 know 的受詞，用 that。
say: Everyone knows that the Earth goes around the Sun.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: He is a person whom everybody respects.
He is a person who everybody respects him.
He is a person whom everybody respects him.
answer: He is a person whom everybody respects.

wrong.He is a person who everybody respects hi: 關係詞 who 已經代替了受詞，後面不能再重複 him。
wrong.He is a person whom everybody respects h: whom 已經是 respects 的受詞，句尾再加 him 就重複了。

why: 關係代名詞已經代表受詞，子句中不能再重複代名詞。
tip: 關係代名詞當受詞時，後面不再重複受詞。
say: He is a person whom everybody respects.

prompt: The teacher asked what we thought of the story. 老師想知道什麼？
options: 我們對這個故事有什麼想法。
我們是否讀過這個故事。
我們什麼時候想到這個故事。
answer: 我們對這個故事有什麼想法。

wrong.我們是否讀過這個故事。: what we thought of 問的是想法，不是有沒有讀過。
wrong.我們什麼時候想到這個故事。: what 問的是內容，when 才是問時間。

why: think of 表示對某事的看法，what 引導名詞子句，問想法的內容。
tip: what we thought of 問的是我們的看法。
say: The teacher asked what we thought of the story.

prompt: 同學說自己當班長壓力很大，你想表示「我能體會你的處境」，哪一句最合適？
options: I can imagine how you feel.
I can imagine how do you feel.
I can imagine what you feeling.
answer: I can imagine how you feel.

how 引導名詞子句時，不用疑問句語序，不能加 do。
feeling 前面少了 are，而且表示感受應該用 how you feel。

why: how you feel 是名詞子句，語序是主詞加動詞，不倒裝。
tip: 名詞子句用 how + 主詞 + 動詞，不用倒裝。
say: I can imagine how you feel.

prompt: 選出最適合的字。
text: The writer, _____ novels are popular among teens, will visit our school.
options: whose
who
whom
answer: whose

wrong.who: who 後面要接動詞，但後面是 novels are，表示「他的小說」需要所有格。
wrong.whom: whom 是受格，後面不會直接接名詞 novels；這裡需要表示所有格的詞。

why: whose novels 表示這位作家的小說，whose 是關係詞的所有格。
tip: 關係詞後直接接名詞表示所屬，用 whose。
say: The writer, whose novels are popular among teens, will visit our school.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I wish I were taller.
I wish I am taller.
I wish I will be taller.
answer: I wish I were taller.

wish 後面表達與現實相反的願望，不能用現在式 am，要用過去式 were。
wish 後面不用 will；與現在事實相反用過去式，不是未來式。

why: I wish 後面接與現在事實相反的願望，動詞用過去式，be 動詞用 were。
tip: I wish 後面接過去式，表示不太可能的願望。
say: I wish I were taller.

prompt: From my point of view, the rule is too strict. 說話者的意思是什麼？
options: 我認為這條規定太嚴格了。
這條規定是從我的觀點產生的。
我看到這條規定很嚴格。
answer: 我認為這條規定太嚴格了。

wrong.這條規定是從我的觀點產生的。: from my point of view 是「依我看」，不是規定的來源。
wrong.我看到這條規定很嚴格。: 這句話表達的是意見判斷，不是用眼睛看到的事實。

why: from my point of view 引導個人意見，表示自己的看法。
tip: from my point of view 後面接的是個人看法。
say: From my point of view, the rule is too strict.
